summary: GRI 411 addresses the rights of indigenous peoples, generally identified as tribal peoples or peoples regarded as indigenous by descent. It contains one disclosure on incidents of violations of their rights and the status of actions taken.

questions.text: Describe how the organization manages this material topic and its related impacts, as required by Disclosure 3-3 in GRI 3 (Material Topics 2021).
questions.hint: Per GRI 3-3: the actual and potential impacts, policy commitments, actions taken, tracking of effectiveness and stakeholder engagement for the topic.

questions.text: Report the total number of identified incidents of violations involving the rights of indigenous peoples during the reporting period and the status of those incidents and actions taken.
questions.hint: a. Total number of identified incidents. b. Status and actions: incident reviewed; remediation plans being implemented; remediation implemented with results reviewed through routine management review; incident no longer subject to action.
